title: Vendor registry (/vendors/list) loads without error for a fresh organization
preconditions: Logged in as org admin of a newly created (zero-vendor) org
expectedResult: Page loads with a correct empty state (no vendors) and no console errors, stats cards render as zero rather than crashing or showing stale mock data.

title: Creating a vendor via the VendorFormWizard succeeds and appears in the registry
steps: Complete the VendorFormWizard with minimal required fields (name, category, riskTier)
expectedResult: A 201 response is returned, the wizard closes, and the new vendor appears in the registry table with status 'active' without a manual page refresh.

title: Trust score widget renders the default bootstrap value (50 / medium) for a newly created vendor
description: TrustScoreService.getByVendor bootstraps a default trust score doc (overallScore:50, riskLevel: medium, trend: stable) the first time a vendor is queried with no existing record.
steps: Open the detail page for a vendor created in the last test with no assessments/evidence yet
expectedResult: The card renders overall score 50 and risk level 'Medium' without an error state, confirming the default bootstrap path works end-to-end through the UI.

title: A freshly generated vendor portal magic link resolves and renders the assessment page
preconditions: An assessment has just had sendLink called, producing a valid, unexpired token
steps: Open the generated magic link in a fresh (unauthenticated) browser session
expectedResult: The vendor portal loads the assessment title and, if no passcode is required, the question list — no Keycloak login prompt appears since the token itself is the auth mechanism.

title: Manual evidence upload (Mode 1) succeeds for a whitelisted PDF under the size limit
steps: Navigate to a vendor's evidence tab and upload a 2 MB PDF via the standard (non-presigned) upload form
Submit with required metadata (title, category, evidenceType)
expectedResult: Upload returns 201, the evidence document appears with status 'draft', version 1, and one file in files[] with a computed SHA-256 checksum — no error toast is shown.

title: Questionnaire template builder loads and lists at least the system default templates
steps: Open the template builder for a new template
expectedResult: The templates list and builder UI load without error; creating a minimal draft template (1 domain, 1 question) and saving succeeds.
